supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of mutation, data flow, cursor lifetime, cache, ordered guard or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: First loop from Reset+1 inclusive; skip blocked positions and tag mismatch. Build local candidate then scan to full end; confirmed returns earlier_pending; no invalidation sets persistent earlier_pending true and continues; invalidation sets blocked_through. Exhaustion always returns null,true even without pending candidate. Docstring does not override actual later-candidate behavior.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of mutation, data flow, cursor lifetime, cache, ordered guard or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Compute bounded limit for cache key; on hit clone candidate or return null. On miss compute limit again. No cache write within method, no assumption that other callers cannot populate it.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of mutation, data flow, cursor lifetime, cache, ordered guard or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Geometry route checks adjacent tags and uses same direct builder (local eligibility still enforced), then scans First+1..limit inclusive. No owner invalidation check; strict opposite-edge update then strict confirmation sets Candle.index and display; refine return ignored; return first completed candidate in First traversal order, not earliest global confirmation.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of mutation, data flow, cursor lifetime, cache, ordered guard or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Public wrapper delegates bound. Break cache is per direction with stored stream length only; int-convert each Break in existing order on miss, store list and return same list reference. No sorting, duplicate check, or mutation freshness check; append-only/monotonicity are caller invariants.

findings.description: Remove implied sorting guarantee and record reuse of original cache list.
findings.resolution: Cache direction and list length; if cached entry nonnull and length unchanged return same list reference; else rebuild int Break values in current stream order. No local sort, duplicate check or freshness check; ascending append-only stream is a caller invariant.
